## Publication Information

**Imprint:** <i>MP</i> (July-September 1890)

**Notes:** This work appeared under the name 'Joanna Harrison' but CMY ascribes it to a [Miss Cheape](../people/person_289.qmd), of St. Andrews, probably Harriette Cheape.
